templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. If [C] persons sit between them and [P1] is to the left of [P2], find total persons in the row.
templates.explanation: Total = Left position + Right position + persons between = [A]+[B]+[C]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] people, [P1] is [A]th from left and [P2] is [B]th from left. [P3] is exactly midway between [P1] and [P2]. [P4] is [K] places right of [P3]. What is [P4]'s position from right?
templates.explanation: [P3] position = (A+B)/2. [P4] position from left = (A+B)/2 + K. From right = N - that + 1

templates.pattern: Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle facing the centre. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P5]. [P3] is 2nd to left of [P1]. [P7] is between [P5] and [P3]. [P2] is opposite [P7]. [P4] is to immediate right of [P8]. How many persons are between [P2] and [P6] in clockwise direction?
templates.explanation: After solving circular arrangement of 8, between [P2] and [P6] clockwise = 3 persons

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] ranks [A]th from front and [B]th from back. [P2] is [K] ranks ahead of [P1]. What is [P2]'s rank from back?
templates.explanation: [P2] is K ahead of [P1]. [P2] rank from front = A-K. From back = N-(A-K)+1 = B+K = [B]+[K]

templates.pattern: Nine persons [P1]-[P9] sit in 3 rows of 3. Row1 faces Row2, Row2 faces Row3. [P1],[P2],[P3] in Row1. [P4],[P5],[P6] in Row2. [P7],[P8],[P9] in Row3. [P1] faces [P4], [P4] faces [P7]. [P2] is to right of [P1]. [P5] is to left of [P4]. Who faces [P2]?

Eight persons [P1]-[P8] sit in a circle. [P1] faces outward, all others face inward. [P2] is to the immediate right of [P1]. [P3] is 3rd to left of [P2]. [P4] is opposite [P3]. [P5] is between [P2] and [P4]. Who is to the immediate left of [P1]?
templates.explanation: Solving arrangement: [P1] faces outward so left/right are reversed. Immediate left of [P1] = [P8]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. [P1] is to the left of [P2]. If they both move [K] places towards each other, how many persons are between them now?
templates.explanation: Original gap = N-A-B. After both move K towards each other, gap reduces by 2K. Between = N-A-B-2K-1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] people, [P1] is at position [A] from left. [P2] is at position [B] from right. Both shift [K] places to the right. What are their new positions from left?
templates.explanation: [P1] new position from left = A+K = [A]+[K]. [P2] new from left = (N-B+1)+K

templates.pattern: In a group of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from front in a column. [P2] is [B]th from front. [P2] is exactly [C] places behind [P3]. What is [P3]'s position from the back?
templates.explanation: [P3] from front = B-C. From back = N-(B-C)+1 = [N]-([B]-[C])+1

templates.pattern: Seven people [P1]-[P7] sit in a circle facing inward. [P1] is 3rd to right of [P6]. [P2] is immediate right of [P1]. [P4] is 2nd to left of [P5]. [P3] is between [P7] and [P2] going clockwise. How many sit between [P4] and [P6] anticlockwise?
templates.explanation: Solving 7-person circular arrangement, between [P4] and [P6] anticlockwise = 2 persons

templates.pattern: Ten people sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B]th from right. If [P1] moves [K] places right and [P2] moves [K] places left, do they now occupy the same position? Total persons = [N].
templates.explanation: [P1] new pos = A+K = [A+K]. [P2] new pos from left = N-B+1-K = [N-B+1-K]. Check if equal.

templates.pattern: Eight students sit in two rows of 4 facing each other. Row A faces south, Row B faces north. [P1] (Row A) is 3rd from left. [P5] (Row B) faces [P1]. [P2] is to immediate left of [P1] in Row A. [P3] is to immediate right of [P5] in Row B. [P4] is opposite [P3]. Which row A person is at the leftmost position?
templates.explanation: Row A: [P4]-[P2]-[P1]-[P6]. Leftmost of Row A = [P4]

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is [A]th from left, [P2] is [B]th from left. They interchange with [P3] (middle person). After interchange, [P1] is [C]th from right. What was [P2]'s original distance from [P1]?
